questions: Q1. Can the V2 deviation score be converted into a reference-calibrated, statistically interpretable event-level assessment without clinical labels?
Q2. Is that calibration valid on sessions not used to build the reference (leave-one-session-out)?
Q3. Does a categorical statement (inside / outside the reference range) meet pre-specified validity, stability, perturbation and reproducibility criteria, or must the output stay continuous?
Q4. Can V2 be repaired (G4c) or improved by a simple alternative using only existing features?
Q5. How reliable is each event's assessment with respect to reference sampling and segmentation?

representations.V2: incumbent: score = sqrt(mean_j z_j^2) over the 4 V2 features.
representations.V2_RC: robust correlation-aware distance on the same 4 robust z: score = sqrt(z' R^-1 z / 4), R = per-fold correlation from the training events' Spearman rho via r = 2 sin(pi*rho/6). Admissible only if every LOSO fold passes the Stage 7 multivariate gate thresholds (>= 10 training events per feature, condition number of R <= 100, max |r_fold - r_pooled| <= 0.2); otherwise not compared.
representations.V2_G4C: G4c repair candidate: rms of robust z over spectral_centroid_mean and spectral_rolloff_std only (drops the two features that failed G4c).

representation_decision_rule: An alternative replaces V2 only if (a) it passes every Stage 8 gate criterion recomputed in this run for that representation (G1a, G1b, G2a-c, G3a, G4a-d, G5a-b; G6 engineering criteria are not representation-specific) including G4c, AND (b) its held-out calibration passes K1 below.
If several qualify: lowest held-out session epsilon^2; ties -> fewer features.
Otherwise V2 is retained and the alternatives are reported as sensitivity analyses.
Any replacement is exploratory (same data) and is labelled as such.

assessment_method.calibration_scores: C = leave-one-session-out scores of the reference's usable events (each scored by a baseline fitted without its own session), so reference events are measured exactly as a new session's events are.
assessment_method.tail_probability: p(s) = (1 + #{c in C : c >= s}) / (|C| + 1)  (conformal p-value; under exchangeability P(p <= alpha) <= alpha).
assessment_method.alpha_rationale: Convention: the central 95% reference interval of reference-interval methodology (e.g. CLSI EP28-A3c), applied one-sided to a non-negative distance. It defines the expected exceedance rate for reference-like events; it is not a detection threshold for any clinical condition. alpha = 0.01 and 0.10 are reported descriptively.
assessment_method.cut: c_alpha = the (n - m)-th smallest calibration score, m = floor(alpha (n + 1) - 1); p(s) <= alpha iff s > c_alpha.

categories.NOT_ASSESSED: event not scoreable (Stage 1 usability rule) - never assessed

assessment_method.if_category_gate_fails: assessment = CONTINUOUS_ONLY for scoreable events (score and p are reported, no category)
assessment_method.deployment_reference: baseline fitted on all usable events; C = LOSO scores of all usable events.
assessment_method.evaluation_reference_per_held_out_sessio: baseline fitted on usable events of sessions != h; C_h = nested LOSO scores of those events (each scored by a baseline fitted on sessions not in {h, own}); held-out events of h are scored by the outer baseline and compared with C_h. No held-out event influences its own reference.

reliability.reference_band: session bootstrap of the calibration set (resample sessions with replacement; B = 2000; seed 20261006): [c_lo, c_hi] = 5th-95th percentiles of the bootstrap c_alpha.
reliability.segmentation_variants: event bounds moved by one detector stride (0.016 s) at the start and/or end: 8 variants (ds, de) in {-1,0,1}^2 \ (0,0); a variant is used when it stays inside the recording and spans >= one detector window (0.2 s). Bounds use the reference float formula (index * stride, min(last * stride + window, duration)).

labels.STABLE: the event score and every variant score lie on the same side of the band: all > c_hi, or all <= c_lo
labels.domain: reported separately (baseline_domain_validated); PRISM hardware audio is not validated

category_gate.K1_marginal_validity: outer-LOSO exceedance rate at alpha = 0.05 over all held-out usable events: the 95% session-bootstrap interval (B = 2000) contains 0.05 AND the point estimate is <= 0.10.
category_gate.K2_reference_stability: deployment reference: (c_hi - c_lo) / (2 c_alpha) <= 0.20 (convention: a cut uncertain by more than +/-20% would make the category depend mainly on which reference sessions were sampled).
category_gate.K3_perturbation_behaviour: held-out usable events under the Stage 6/8 perturbations (perturbed_features.csv), each scored by its own outer-fold reference: the fraction OUTSIDE_REFERENCE_RANGE is non-decreasing over noise 30 -> 20 -> 10 dB SNR and over tilt a = 0.5 -> 0.9; and |fraction(gain) - fraction(identity)| <= 0.02 at every event and whole-recording gain level.
category_gate.K4_reproducibility: a complete second run produces byte-identical CSV/JSON outputs.
category_gate.decision: categorical assessment adopted iff K1-K4 all pass; otherwise CONTINUOUS_ONLY.

reported_not_gated: per-session exceedance with exact binomial 95% intervals; overdispersion (chi-square heterogeneity of per-session counts, parametric-bootstrap p under a common rate)
